description: This file defines the SSLOptions class in Scala, which encapsulates SSL configuration options for Apache Spark, including methods to create SSL context factories and configuration providers, as well as parsing SSL settings from Spark configurations.

classes.name: SSLOptions
classes.description: A case class representing SSL configuration options with methods to create SSL context factories and configuration providers, and to parse settings from Spark configurations.

methods.name: createJettySslContextFactoryServer
methods.description: Creates an optional Jetty SSL context factory based on the SSL options.

methods.name: createConfigProvider
methods.description: Generates a configuration provider object from the SSL options and Spark configuration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SSL options with passwords masked.
